q.line: He coughs as he passes her Ford Mustang
stanza: Scanning life through the picture window
He coughs as he passes her Ford Mustang
But Heaven forbid, she'll take anything
But the freak, and his type, all for nothing
He misses a step and cuts his hand, but
Showing nothing, he swoops like a song
She cries "Where have all Papa's heroes gone?"

q.line: Well I used to go out in a Mustang
stanza: Well I used to go out in a Mustang
Till me and your mama made you in the back
And I sold it to buy her a ring

partner.line: Till me and your mama made you in the back

stanza: For a B-1 bomber that'll blow your mind
Listen for the sound of glass
For a B-1 bomber from Flint knapptime

partner.line: Listen for the sound of glass
